absent: Hardware programming sequence inside backend set and get callbacks.
Enablement predicate and fixed range support detection.
Addition path overlap validation and free region selection rules.
Numeric values of user control commands and layout of user structures.
Remaining power flag slots beyond the listed names and empty slot handling.
Software map rebuild and copy behavior after programming.
Error codes for file scoped addition path not shown in fragments.
Full suspend resume ordering relative to other system components.

findings.text: Management interface offers byte granularity add and delete plus page granularity delete, all refusing work when the feature is disabled and checking alignment before delegating to page level handling.
Write combining helper creates a combining reservation and returns a biased handle, while companion helpers remove a reservation from a handle and translate a handle back to a register index.
Counter exclusion offers separate acquire and release operations for counter registers and for event selector registers keyed by machine register number.
Primary registration allocates snapshot storage while header fallback provides a no operation variant, and save entry snapshots fixed ranges on one online processor when active.
Two memory types are treated as compatible when either is uncacheable, or when one is writethrough and the other is writeback, with all other pairings incompatible.
Base and size supplied in byte units must each be multiples of the page size, otherwise the request is rejected after emitting diagnostic output.

Write combining support is refused on two vintage host bridge cases, one ServerWorks low revision family and one Intel multiprocessor chipset, otherwise the decision is delegated to the active backend probe when present.

Deletion accepts a negative selector to mean search by matching extent, validates the resulting index and non empty state and positive use count, decrements the count, and clears hardware only when the count falls below one.

File scoped deletion interprets its extent either as bytes requiring page granularity or directly as pages, performs lookup deletion, then decrements the caller file private count for the affected register.

Text control accepts either a disable directive with a register number or a triple directive giving base plus size plus type, enforces page granularity and known type names, and forwards normalized page units to the add path.

Control multiplexing distinguishes creation with file accounting from creation without accounting, plus removal with accounting, unconditional removal, and query, each available in byte and page unit forms with parallel compat forms.

Combining reservation is a successful no operation when page attribute handling is active or the range feature is disabled, otherwise it allocates a combining entry and biases the returned identifier.
Handle teardown ignores non positive values and warns on small positive values below the bias, while index translation returns negative one below the bias and the unbiased value otherwise.
Translation from register number to allocator bit depends on vendor and family, with separate counter and selector bases and with strided decoding for newer AMD families.
Allocator treats indices beyond a fixed maximum as unmanaged and reports success without touching state, otherwise acquisition uses an atomic set and release clears the corresponding bit.

Processor reporting prints package and sibling and core topology on symmetric builds and prints legacy defect plus floating point plus identifier level lines in one configuration and a reduced set in another.

Suspend captures every variable range into a snapshot array and resume rewrites only entries whose saved size is non zero, with registration allocating the snapshot array sized by the live range count.
Sequential display iterates all variable ranges, resets accounting for empty slots, scales non empty sizes to kilobyte or megabyte units, and reports base plus size plus count plus symbolic type.

Opening requires an installed backend with query support and administrative privilege, while module initialization requires one of several range related CPU capabilities before publishing the control file.
Release drains each per file count to zero by repeatedly deleting the corresponding register, then frees the per file store and clears the association.

Late initialization copies any existing map, warns about firmware state unless a cleanup already changed it, and registers suspend handling only when caching control still includes the range mechanism.
Range deletion serializes against processor hotplug with a read lock and against concurrent range changes with a global mutex held across lookup validation and update.
Hardware programming runs a small rendezvous callback on every online processor under a stopped machine context, then rebuilds the software map after all processors have applied the entry.
Counter and selector ownership use distinct bitmaps updated with atomic bit set on acquire and plain clear on release, without additional locking in the shown fragments.

Cross processor request carrier holds start plus length plus selector plus tag, corresponding respectively to smp_base with smp_size with smp_reg with smp_type, used to convey a programming request to every processor.

Backend vector begins with a count named var_regs, then offers program and query operations named set with get, plus region search named get_free_region, plus validation named validate_add_page, plus combining probe named have_wrcomb.
Programming context preserves processor state with five members called flags with cr4val with deftype_lo with deftype_hi with ccr3.
Snapshot entry stores three members called ltype with lbase with lsize, representing cached type plus base plus size for one range.
Suspend framework wiring pairs a save callback with a restore callback in an operations object referenced through a member called ops by a registration object.
Control file operations connect members called proc_open with proc_read with proc_lseek with proc_write with proc_ioctl with proc_compat_ioctl with proc_release to the range handlers.
Global range state uses count called num_var_ranges with table called mtrr_usage_table with lock called mtrr_mutex with vector called mtrr_if.

Variable slot moves from empty to occupied on first allocation, stays occupied while its use count remains positive across repeated references, and returns to empty when the last reference is removed.
File association moves from no accounting to positive counts through file scoped operations and returns to zero for every slot during release which deletes as many times as counted.
Allocator bit moves from free to owned on successful atomic claim and back to free on explicit release, while out of range inputs bypass state and are always treated as externally managed.
Power management moves from unregistered to registered with allocated snapshot, then cycles between live state and snapshot on suspend and from snapshot back to hardware on resume.
Published control file serves as the privileged user entry for listing plus text updates plus numeric control plus cleanup.
Four allocator routines serve as the driver entry for excluding performance registers from watchdog use.
Three physical combining helpers serve as the driver entry for requesting and releasing and translating combining reservations.
Fixed range saver serves as a suspend oriented entry that delegates work to the first online processor when fixed support is present.
Host bridge lookup must release its device reference on every exit path, and permitting combining on the listed errata chipsets risks corruption from unordered evictions.
User supplied text and control structures are bounded and copied with fault checking, with malformed directives and unknown type names rejected before any hardware change.
Queries that would not fit the user visible width are hidden by returning zeroed base plus size plus type rather than truncated values.
Attempts to delete an unused slot or a slot with zero use count only warn and fail, leaving hardware untouched and preserving the error for the caller.
Suspend without allocated snapshot storage fails instead of writing through a null pointer, and resume skips empty snapshot entries.
Combining teardown warns when given a small positive handle that cannot be a biased identifier, indicating caller confusion between raw index and handle.
Physical combining handle bias has decimal value one thousand, added on allocation and subtracted on teardown and translation.
Range change notification uses three single bit flags with values one for fixed plus two for variable plus four for default type.
Performance counter allocator manages bit positions up to a maximum of sixty six, with larger positions treated as unmanaged.
Power capability name table holds thirty two slots indexed by feature bit, with early slots describing temperature plus frequency plus voltage plus thermal plus boost plus feedback capabilities.
